defs.def: a person who works in an office, working for another person, dealing with letters and telephone calls, typing, keeping records, arranging meetings with people, etc. 秘书

ex.s: Ban Ki-moon (born in 1944), a South Korean diplomat who was the eighth Secretary-General of the United Nations from 2007 to 2016.
ex.t: 潘基文(1944年出生),韩国外交官,2007年至2016年担任第八届联合国秘书长。

ex.s: Then the secretary called Liu Dong to tell him their decision.
ex.t: 后来秘书打电话给刘东，告诉他他们的决定。

ex.s: The president and the secretary later came up with an idea.
ex.t: 总统和秘书后来想出了一个主意。

defs.def: an official of a club, society, etc. who deals with writing letters, keeping records, and making business arrangements （俱乐部、社团等的）干事，文书

ex.s: Liu Dong: The secretary of the Adventure Club said I should be friendlier and get on better with others.
ex.t: 刘东：冒险俱乐部的秘书说，我应该更加友善，更好地与他人相处。

defs.def: the head of a government department, chosen by the President 部长；大臣
(in Britain) an assistant of a government minister, an ambassador, etc. （英国的大臣、大使等的）助理
